answer: Sybil attackers can be throttled by requiring each identity to complete a verifiable contribution ladder before earning voting weight. Picture the climb as an upward spiral: each turn demands a fresh, peer-reviewed task, so fake identities spinning off copycat siblings stay stuck at the bottom. Tie progress to a scarce resource burned like fuel — a ferrous hardware token, for example, where forging many keys gets costly — so sockpuppets cannot multiply for free. Honest new agents still arrive quickly, like a comet, since the ladder measures real work rather than age.
